steps.sql: SELECT id, node_type, status, JSON_EXTRACT(common_variable, '$.batchId') as batch_id FROM workflow_record_log WHERE id > 4000000 AND JSON_EXTRACT(common_variable, '$.linkId') = '${newLinkId}' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20
steps.description: E2E-26: DB查询新链路产生的workflow record
E2E-26: 试运行后workflow_record_log已创建record

steps.sql: SELECT node_type, status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM workflow_record_log WHERE id > 4000000 AND JSON_EXTRACT(common_variable, '$.batchId') IN (SELECT DISTINCT JSON_EXTRACT(common_variable, '$.batchId') FROM workflow_record_log WHERE JSON_EXTRACT(common_variable, '$.linkId') = '${newLinkId}' AND id > 4000000) GROUP BY node_type, status ORDER BY MIN(id) ASC
steps.description: E2E-27: 按节点类型统计各环节执行状态

steps.condition: exists node_type in ('gen_img', 'approve', 'hd_enhance') with status in ('SUCCESS', 'HANDLING', 'TO_SUBMIT')
steps.description: E2E-27: 生图/审核/高清化节点均已创建并进入执行

steps.sql: SELECT wi.id, JSON_EXTRACT(wi.common_variable, '$.passedImg') as passed_img, JSON_EXTRACT(wi.common_variable, '$.seller_id') as seller_id FROM g_workflow_instance wi WHERE wi.id > 4000000 AND JSON_EXTRACT(wi.common_variable, '$.linkId') = '${newLinkId}' ORDER BY wi.id DESC LIMIT 5
steps.description: E2E-28: 查询workflow_instance中的passedImg传递

steps.condition: row_count > 0 AND (passed_img contains 'http' OR seller_id is not null)
steps.description: E2E-28: 端到端数据流转 — passedImg/seller_id正确传递

steps.sql: SELECT r1.id, r1.node_type as upstream, r1.status as up_status, r2.id as down_id, r2.node_type as downstream, r2.status as down_status FROM workflow_record_log r1 JOIN workflow_record_log r2 ON JSON_EXTRACT(r2.common_variable, '$.batchId') = JSON_EXTRACT(r1.common_variable, '$.batchId') AND r2.id > r1.id WHERE r1.id > 4000000 AND JSON_EXTRACT(r1.common_variable, '$.linkId') = '${newLinkId}' AND r1.status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY r1.id ASC LIMIT 10
steps.description: E2E-29: 验证上游SUCCESS后下游节点被触发
E2E-29: 上游节点SUCCESS后下游节点已被创建（链式触发验证）
